install.note: Kimi CLI by Moonshot AI. The binary is `kimi` (curl installs to ~/.kimi-code/bin and prepends it to PATH; restart the shell or source the rc file before verifying). This is the command-line client, not Kimi Desktop. Built on Pi's pi-tui TUI library but a SEPARATE product — do NOT install `pi` or `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`. On Windows, Git for Windows is required (Kimi CLI uses bundled Git Bash); set KIMI_SHELL_PATH if bash.exe is in a custom location. Native installers do not require Node.js; the npm alternative requires Node.js 22.19.0+. Verify with `kimi --version`.

blocked_regions.zh-CN: code.kimi.com is mainland-China-reachable, and the curl installer downloads the binary directly from code.kimi.com/kimi-code/binaries (NOT GitHub Releases), so it works in mainland China without a mirror. npm install also works via npmmirror if preferred: `npm install -g @moonshot-ai/kimi-code --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com`.

first_run.description: On first launch run `/login` inside Kimi CLI and choose Kimi Code OAuth or a Moonshot AI Open Platform API key. Any OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible provider can also be added via the [providers.<name>] table in config.toml. Kimi CLI and Desktop share this global configuration.

identity_guard.description: Kimi CLI is Moonshot AI's terminal client (command `kimi`, npm package `@moonshot-ai/kimi-code`). It is separate from Kimi Desktop, although both clients share ~/.kimi-code/config.toml. Do not download the desktop installer when the user requests Kimi CLI.
